checks_run.procedure: Direct review of the D-181 hook and its 12 consumers (git diff ad52a56..12dc33e). Covered: termination, cancellation, error handling and the authorization scope of what it lists, with the list route, the cursor, QueryState and the client's session binding.
checks_run.command: git diff ad52a56..12dc33e -- apps packages; read apps/web/src/api/queries.ts:230-283, apps/web/src/api/client.ts:380-446, apps/web/src/components/States.tsx:196-230, apps/api/src/modules/transformations/routes.ts:95-142, apps/api/src/modules/platform/cursor.ts:61-70, apps/api/src/modules/access/policy.ts:192-224
checks_run.expected: The cursor loop always ends and never hides a cut. Cancellation stops it. A failed page fails the whole list. The listed set is exactly the server-scoped list.
checks_run.actual:
Termination. There are three bounds: a null nextCursor (queries.ts:264), a repeated-cursor error (:265) and a hard 1000-page cap that throws (:237, :269). The server's keyset is strictly monotonic, (col, t.id) </> cursor (routes.ts:131-139). The cursor is bound to the filter hash (:101).

Cancellation. The TanStack signal goes to every page request (:279 -> :261 -> client.ts:410), and AbortError is rethrown (client.ts:412).

Errors. A failed page rejects the queryFn, so there is never partial data. QueryState shows loading, no-permission, error with retry, or a stale banner over the last complete list. All 12 screens use it.

Session. A per-request generation check (client.ts:387/414/422) means two identities' pages are never concatenated.

Scope. The hook adds no endpoint. scopeFilter(principal, 'transformation.read') applies to every page (routes.ts:114), and the cursor carries a position only.

RulesPage/RulePage now gate the editor on the query. Because lists are filtered (200 with an empty list) rather than 403, an editor with no transformation grant still gets the editor: no regression.

Wave AB (FE-AB1) is CSS, a span wrapper and TableScrollRegion, presentation only. The scan of the added lines finds no HTML sinks, no storage writes (only localStorage.clear() in a test), no external URL and no secrets (04-structure.log).

Observations, not defects:
- with updatedAt:desc, a row updated mid-walk can be missed until the next fetch. This is inherent to keyset paging, and it cannot duplicate;
- the client memory bound is 100k rows, with no change to the server's per-request limit.

D-182's unexplained e2e failure: the hook is mounted only on HealthCheckEntryPage (HealthCheckPage.tsx:48-57). The failing assertion is on the assessment page, which neither mounts the hook nor invalidates the transformations prefix. I find no code path from D-181 to that step. The cause stays not established, as D-182 discloses accurately. qa is assigned to examine it, and I did not run the web e2e suite. Details: 10-source-review-notes.md.

- S1, TO @ BU a1 (inheriting), both sorts: 3 pages, 250 items = exactly a1 + a1x, none of a2, org B or the archived one; no duplicates; codes in order.
- S2, TO @ org A: 3 pages, 290 items, none of org B.

- S6: the archived row appears only with includeArchived.

The probe needed two corrections of my own fixture and expectations before the final run. They are disclosed here, and none of them is a product failure:
- Trial run (06-repro-new-probe-trial.log, EXIT 1, all 7 skipped): my fixture set archived_at alone and violated the CHECK transformation_archive_complete (0002:35). I added archive_reason and archived_by.
- Second run (its log was overwritten by the final run, same file name): 4 failed, 3 passed. Two wrong expectations of mine caused it:
  - S1 used TL @ BU, a non-inheriting grant, which by design matches only BU-level records (policy.ts:211-212), so 0 items;
  - S5 expected 403, but lists are filtered, not refused (ADR-0006; scopeFilter returns FALSE), so 200 with 0 items;
  - S6 failed as a consequence of S1.
  I changed S1 to an inheriting TO @ BU grant and made S5 assert the empty list. Both are recorded in the final probe file.
